rationale.conceptual: The method applies standard membrane theory and lumped-element acoustics with a well-documented voltage modification. All formulas (Yeoh model, modal series, lumped acoustic elements, radiation impedance) are given directly in the paper, requiring careful arithmetic and truncation of series but no novel derivation or deep domain-specific insight.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has four distinct output artifacts (center displacement, mode shape, resonance frequencies, voltage dependence) that require unit conversions (SPL to pressure) and evaluation of a double series over multiple coordinate points. While orchestration is simple (a single script suffices), it involves several steps with interdependencies (prestress → compliance → resonance).

difficulty.reasoning: Task implements an explicit analytical electroacoustic model with all required equations provided; the main difficulty is correctly evaluating a double series for static deflection and combining lumped acoustic parameters with the voltage-dependent stress reduction. Purely CPU-based, no large data or training.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The model is computed analytically with no training or large dataset; all inputs are a few constants and dimensions, and the computation runs in milliseconds on a CPU.
